Jet Ski rentals are a great way to live life to the fullest this summer without breaking your budget. Located in Utsch's Marina at the base of the Cape May Bridge, East Coast's skis are waiting for you! WE RENT EXCITEMENT! Experience the thrill of blasting off on a brand new three-seater waverunners and jet skis! services.name: Harbor Cruises
services.desc: Explore the harbors of Cape May and The Wildwoods for a fun, family-friendly time on the water. Cruise the Cape May Harbor with Cape Island Hoppers on our Sun Chaser Pontoon Lounge. The boat has ample room for six passengers and soft seating for an exceptionally comfortable experience while aboard. She is U.S.C.G. safety vessel inspected and outfitted with all the required Coast Guard equipment necessary to ensure our passengers safety while aboard our vessel. Hop on board one of our boat trips for a fun and exciting way to enjoy your vacation. We offer open boat and private cruises. Experience the beautiful Cape May harbor waters and surrounding sites. A great time for friends and family!

You will discover that with the increased buoyancy of a SUP board, balance and coordination are relatively easy to master.
